items.statement: The submission independently treats both named endpoint geometries with explicit neutral-singlet charge/multiplicity and reports convergence/validation evidence.
items.expected: Two endpoint records identify reactant_1 and product_3, each with charge 0, multiplicity 1, energy, convergence and validation evidence.

items.statement: The endpoint energy difference is formed under one disclosed thermochemical convention.
items.expected: A reproducible product-minus-reactant Gibbs-energy calculation in kcal/mol with stated model, solvent, temperature and standard state.

items.statement: The computed endpoint conversion is compared with source-supported product formation energetics.
items.expected: A signed product-minus-reactant free-energy value and an honest limitation-aware comparison.

items.statement: The submission distinguishes computed electronic/mechanistic evidence from unsupported certainty about a pathway or oxidation-state assignment.
items.expected: A discriminating diagnostic, independent interpretation and explicit limitations.
